issue_request: FHIR-43451 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R6 asking that DeviceDispense be analyzed against the Workflow Event pattern. The final resolution required changing DeviceDispense.eventHistory to DeviceDispense.relevantHistory and adding workflow mappings for identifier, basedOn, category, device-to-product, location, and relevantHistory.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied in commit 4d63079dde. That commit updated source/devicedispense/structuredefinition-DeviceDispense.xml by adding the requested workflow mappings and renaming the differential element from eventHistory to relevantHistory; the current source still contains those changes.
additional_context: DeviceDispense is not listed as an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and current core narrative links DeviceDispense to the OO incubator continuous build rather than a core devicedispense.html page. The linked OO incubator StructureDefinition JSON also has DeviceDispense.relevantHistory and the requested workflow mappings. OO 2025-09-30 minutes confirm the Persuasive with Modification vote. The only remaining eventHistory hit under source/devicedispense is a checked-in SVG diagram artifact.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative StructureDefinition already matches the approved Jira resolution, the current core build is not missing an active DeviceDispense resource edit, and the external OO incubator surface also matches the requested alignment. The stale generated-looking SVG was intentionally left alone because it is not an authoritative standalone source target.
